what_happened: Both filed defects reproduced exactly via direct measurement (grep for the hardcoded path; direct suite_selection_select re-run on specs/ROADMAP.md); existing enforcement precedent (validate-artifact.sh advisory-first pattern + hooks/validate-plan-write.sh auto-invocation) made the defect-2 lint-vs-prose ruling straightforward with no new gate wiring needed.

Research report recommendation 3 named the wrong per-phase field as the lint's path source (**Files:** step bullets); the structured carrier plan-format.md and plan-file-scope-harvest.sh actually use is **Files to modify**:. Corrected at plan time and recorded as a Research Integration deviation, with the harvester-grammar reuse made an explicit Scope Hypothesis for Phase 3.

The research report's ~50ms selector measurement made the prose-vs-lint ruling decisive rather than a judgment call, and re-running suite_selection_select on this plan's own three touched paths produced real covering suites for every non-final phase, so the plan's own Tier Justification lines quote measured output and the plan file itself becomes the new lint's first live positive fixture.

Gate 3 doc-lint Rule R (index-entries.json line_count) fails against plan-format.md and three unrelated files; this is pre-existing concurrent-sibling drift (index-entries.json was already dirty at session start per git status), not caused by this phase's content. generate-context-line-counts.sh must run against a deployed tree, so it cannot be corrected mid-phase without clobbering sibling in-flight edits; it is expected to self-resolve when deploy-headless.sh runs Phase 5's redeploy and regenerates line counts from the final source-store state.

test-orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh fails with 279 passed/25 failed, confirmed pre-existing and unrelated to this task: reproduced identically with validate-artifact.sh reverted to its HEAD (pre-dispatch) content, so the failure is not caused by the Tier Justification measurement check. Failures concern orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh's own research/plan/implement status-transition logic (researching/planning/implementing persisted_status), an unrelated subsystem. Not chased further per out-of-scope guidance; test-validate-artifact.sh itself passes cleanly.

The new Tier Justification measurement check, on its first live run against this task's own plan, caught a real instance of exactly the pattern defect 2 describes: Phase 4's Tier Justification named only one of its two touched files' covering suites, deferring the other by cross-reference instead of measuring it directly. Fixed by naming the full measured union. This is independent confirmation the check works as intended, not a contrived fixture.

Building the Phase 4 fixture pair surfaced two subtle, genuine edge cases in the Phase 3 check's claim-extraction heuristic before they could reach production: (1) a fixed literal placeholder path for the 'genuinely unmapped' sentinel fixture self-matched via suite_selection_select's grep-based reference stratum once written into this test file's own source; (2) a real-suite path whose own basename looked like a test-*.sh file caused the claim-extraction token scan to misread the measured-path argument mention as part of the claim. Both fixed (PID-suffixed path; non-test-shaped real-suite path) with the reasoning recorded inline.

deploy-headless.sh's built-in post-deploy verify-deploy.sh call exited 3 (landed_verify_red) after this task's Phase 5 redeploy. Both findings confirmed pre-existing and out of scope per the dispatch's own sibling-context note: gate10 (validate-state.sh --deep) 30s wrapper-timeout flake (passes standalone: exit 0, 21 passed/0 failed), and the dead-command-recommendation lint's 2 /ide findings in the memory extension (memory-setup.md, memory-troubleshooting.md). Neither relates to plan-format.md, validate-artifact.sh, or test-validate-artifact.sh. This task's own scoped verification (gates 3,4 plus the measured test-validate-artifact.sh suite subset, per the Batch Gate Deferral directive) passed cleanly.
git-commit-phase.sh dropped 'agent-system/extensions/core/index-entries.json' from a phase commit pathspec: not contained in this task's declared file_scope.
